flags.why: “Buồn ngủ” means feeling sleepy, whereas the translation says the speaker fell asleep.
flags.fix: This film is so dull that I felt sleepy halfway through.

flags.why: This historical sense means land, rather than confiscation or redistribution of land ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-th%E1%BB%95%20%C4%91%E1%BB%8Ba)).
The entry omits the common sense of misleading information used to obscure the truth, as in “tung hỏa mù” ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-h%E1%BB%8Fa%20m%C3%B9)).
flags.fix: noun | smokescreen; misleading information used to confuse people or conceal the truth

flags.why: This use is mainly Southern and needs a regional label ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/lat-eCzSMpZs7Jw8z.html)).
